note: Every area of the museum, named once. Hand-built rooms are listed here with what they hold; the data-built wings (museum/world/wings) describe themselves. The map, the rail, the registry (docs/ROOMS.md) and the studio's 'where to see it' all read these names. `exhibits` name catalogue products (museum/catalog/products.json) or edition groups.

areas.name: The Sanctuary
areas.sub: Eight Bike Porn films, eight bikes

areas.name: The Gallery Nave
areas.sub: Four themed floors, four themed rooms

areas.name: St. George
areas.text: One canyon silhouette from the aisle. Up here the floor is the rock itself: terracotta, with a warm seam.

areas.name: Las Vegas
areas.text: A dark floor that keeps the light. The sculpture in the hall is the same study, seen from the Queen K.

areas.name: Nice
areas.text: Pale glass underfoot, the colour of the bay on a still morning.

areas.name: Kona
areas.text: Basalt, and a line of heat. The same coast as the hall, one storey closer to the weather.

areas.name: Bio
areas.text: A Speedmax taken by the room. Vines have the frame, pods sit on the floor, and the walls are the same green as the growth.

areas.name: Horror
areas.text: One bulb over a Speedmax at the end of the passage. The corridor is narrower than the room. If the eyes blink, you were looking.

areas.name: Alien
areas.text: Four rings over a Speedmax, and a scan that does not care what it passes through. Cold light, no weather.

areas.name: Zombie
areas.text: They keep to the walls. A Speedmax is still on the block in the middle of the yard. The air is the colour of a bruise that has started to heal.
